name: College Placement Portal
brief: Build a web portal for the college Training and Placement Office (TPO). Students maintain profiles and resumes, companies post drives and jobs, students apply, and the TPO tracks applications, shortlists and offers with an admin dashboard and reports. Email notifications for new drives and status changes. Past placement records from spreadsheets must be migrated. Team of eight; target go-live by mid-January for the placement season, about eleven weeks.

risks.title: Messy legacy placement data
risks.cause: Past placement records are kept in inconsistent spreadsheets across batches
risks.event: Records need manual cleaning before import
risks.effect: Data migration takes several extra days
risks.response: Collect sample files in week 1 and write a cleaning script with a TPO-approved field mapping

risks.title: Lead developer unavailable
risks.cause: Developers are also students with exam and lab duties
risks.event: The lead developer is unavailable for a week during build
risks.response: Pair a second developer on the workflow module and keep design notes in the repo

risks.title: New report requests mid-build
risks.cause: The TPO sees early demos and thinks of extra reports
risks.event: New report types are requested after the spec is signed off
risks.response: Freeze report list at spec sign-off; route new requests to a post-launch backlog

risks.title: UAT clashes with semester exams
risks.cause: UAT is planned near end-semester exams
risks.event: TPO staff and student testers are unavailable
risks.response: Book UAT slots with the TPO in advance and keep a reserve week before launch

risks.title: College mail server throttles bulk email
risks.cause: The college SMTP server limits outgoing messages per hour
risks.event: Bulk drive notifications are throttled or rejected
risks.effect: Notifications must be reworked onto another service
risks.response: Use a transactional email service with a free tier instead of the college SMTP server

risks.title: Integration defects in application workflow
risks.cause: Modules are built in parallel by different developers
risks.event: Status changes break across profile, job and application modules
risks.effect: Integration testing finds many defects and needs a fix cycle
risks.response: Agree API contracts in design and run a mid-build integration smoke test

risks.title: Poorly documented college SSO
risks.cause: The college single sign-on has little documentation
risks.event: SSO integration takes longer than planned
risks.response: Spike SSO in the design phase and fall back to email login if it is not working by build week 2

risks.title: Hosting approval delayed
risks.cause: College IT must approve the hosting provider and domain
risks.effect: Staging and production setup are delayed
risks.response: Submit the hosting request in week 1 and prepare a temporary staging server

risks.title: Late accessibility issues
risks.cause: Accessibility is not checked during visual design
risks.event: Screen-reader and contrast issues are found on the frontend
risks.response: Run an automated accessibility checker on wireframes and each new screen
